text:
maria: heads-up — int4 bringup for ranker-v2 shows a NDCG@10 drop of ~1.1% on holdout A but a small +0.2% on our prod-like mix. suspect anchor-set density mismatch :thinking:

maria: quick snapshot:
```
holdout_A: ndcg@10 0.412 -> 0.401 (-1.1pp)
prod_mix:  ndcg@10 0.398 -> 0.400 (+0.2pp)
tie_freq:  base 1.2% -> int4 4.8%
```

kevin: by "anchor-set density" you mean avg relevant candidates per query?

maria: yes. our anchor set is curated (high-quality labels) and many queries have multiple relevant docs. density=avg rels/query.

anton: could be score compression from quantization causing more ties near topk. check topk tie frequency and softmax temp effects.

sam: try this quick slice cmd: `ndcg_slice.py --slice anchor_density:low,med,high --models base,int4 --holdout holdout_A` — will print per-slice deltas.

ci-bot: perf-tests triggered for run 1753216543 (job #8231) :rocket:

lisa: another angle: are we sure the eval harness tokenization and truncation match prod? small whitespace/casing diffs can flip short-query rerankers under quantization.

maria: good call — looks like harness used spm v1.2 but the model onboarding steps assume spm v1.3 tokenization. planning to normalize and re-run.

kevin: also isolate candidate-pool-size. int4 might produce higher variance; if pool is small top1 could flip even if overall ndcg stable.

anton: +1 — try resampling candidate pool to fixed sizes (50, 100, 200) and compare top1/top5 regression.

maria: running resample now (resample script: `scripts/resample_anchor.sh --target-density 2.3 --seed 42`) — will post results when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: quick update — resampled to equal density across slices: NDCG@10 gap shrank to -0.2pp. tie_freq dropped 4.8% -> 1.1% after token normalization (spm v1.3).

sam: great, looks like tokenization mismatch + anchor density explains most of the delta. can we make a preflight check in rankbench to fail onboarding if tokenizer mismatch or anchor histogram mismatch > 10%?

lisa: I'll add a preflight rule in rankbench (PR incoming). will include checks: tokenizer-version, anchor_density_histogram, candidate_pool_size.

kevin: once PR is up let's gate int4 bringup behind that and re-run the int4 smoke. thanks for triage team :thumbsup:
